name: canvas-fractal-grid
title: Fractal Dot Grid
description: A full-bleed grid of small blue dots over a soft pastel gradient, with a glowing halo and gentle wave that follow the pointer.
use: You need a light, quiet page background with a little life that still leaves text readable.
avoid: It is decorative and always animating; on weak devices the per-frame canvas and glow cost adds up.
a11y: A decorative canvas with no text and no reduced-motion branch; the dot animation and gradient loop always run. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale cream page is covered in tiny evenly spaced blue dots. Behind them a blurred pastel blob of pink, peach and lavender drifts, and a small bright blue halo marks the cursor.
behaves: A soft glow trails the pointer, pushing nearby dots outward in a slow wave; the pastel gradient behind it also shifts colour over a long loop.
customise: Dot size, spacing, opacity, colour, wave strength and radius, gradients and noise are props; the pastel palette defaults need source edits.
weight: heavy: A canvas redraws the dot field every frame, plus gradient and glow layers.
